dimensions.assessment: Directly involves CISA personnel and leadership, while indirectly relating to federal, state, local, Tribal, territorial, and international cybersecurity stakeholders consulted during the assessment.
dimensions.evidence: The Director of the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) of the Department of Homeland Security shall conduct a force structure assessment

dimensions.assessment: Requires a comprehensive study and report on agency resources, personnel numbers, training, and certifications without immediately altering operational powers.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than one year after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Director of CISA shall submit to the Committee on Homeland Security... a report detailing the results

dimensions.assessment: Incurs administrative costs within CISA to conduct the assessment and compile the report for Congress, but does not appropriate specific new funding or authorize spending.
Directs a federal agency to evaluate its responsibilities across 12 specific domains ranging from federal information security to emerging technologies and international cooperation.
dimensions.evidence: The assessment conducted under subsection (a) shall include an assessment of the resources and total number of personnel necessary to carry out the mission of CISA

dimensions.assessment: Mandates a one-time assessment and report submitted within one year of enactment, representing a temporary administrative requirement.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than one year after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Director of CISA shall submit to the Committee on Homeland Security

missing_information: The current total number of CISA personnel and resource shortfalls before the assessment is completed.
Any funding amounts allocated to carry out the assessment.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill mandates an internal force structure assessment and report by the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) regarding its resources, personnel, and training.
